policy.basis: successful request with applicable historical start; earliest request end, initial capture and completion; reject future timestamps

automated_tests.data: fabricated fixtures, simulated clients and test keys only
covered: short history, pending, calibration and empty records are independent of freshness
30-day successful requests cover 7 days; 7-day requests do not cover 30 days
search all successful requests; newer narrow sync does not hide older applicable broad sync
threshold boundary, UTC midnight and clock rollback

two runtimes observe the shared worker and reopened runtime reuses success
conditional decision is rechecked inside the shared service lock
network, client construction and page-budget interruption preserve checkpoints and old views

clock rollback does not hide a newer failed run; another runtime's success clears old runtime error
